description: This file defines mock classes for the IMediaKeys and IMediaKeysFactory interfaces used in the Rialto media framework, primarily for testing purposes. It includes mock method declarations for media key session management, DRM store operations, and factory creation.

classes.name: MediaKeysMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaKeys interface for testing media key operations.

classes.name: MediaKeysFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaKeysFactory interface for creating MediaKeys instances in tests.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks selecting a key ID for a given key session.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Mocks checking if a key exists in a session.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Mocks creating a new media key session.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Mocks generating a license request for a key session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Mocks loading an existing key session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Mocks updating a key session with response data.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Mocks setting DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the DRM store hash.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the key store hash.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the LDL sessions limit.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the last DRM error code for a session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Mocks creating a new IMediaKeys instance for a given key system.
